phases.Qualification:
EU001-D1: The other six posts have different start/end histories. Vainikkala freight rail continued. The renewed December 15 closure is a separate episode and must not be bridged across the temporary opening.

EU001-C7P1: December 15 is only a legal handoff to EU002, not reopening. These posts did not share the December 14 opening at Vaalimaa/Niirala; freight rail remains excluded.

Contemporary passenger evidence recovered in the second audit: Yle’s December 14 report records arrivals at both reopened posts that day. Its Russian-language morning report, inspected as a substantive indexed extract, reports 324 people travelling into Russia and 124 into Finland via Vaalimaa by 08:00, and Niirala opening at 08:00. UNN reproduces the border-guard statement and Yle observations. These reports support the existing December 14 scoped endpoint; they do not establish first-vehicle timestamps for every traffic category. phases.Movement / crossing / phase scope: Hungarian land entry under initial nationwide regime
phases.Qualification: March 17, 2020 is the formal onset of the general foreign-entry restriction, with citizen return and discretionary exceptions. Changing commuter/resident exceptions and bilateral easing preclude an unchanged March-to-June closure. June 5 permits Austrian, Czech and Slovak citizens unrestricted entry. The June 18 Hungarian embassy notice and Decree 291/2020 now establish broader EU/EEA/Swiss and qualifying family access, with UK citizens excluded from that category and separate Serbian permission. phases.Movement / crossing / phase scope: Moldova's non-exempt foreign-entry prohibition, ending here only for origins classed green on September 1
phases.Qualification: March 17, 2020 onset differs by twenty hours between the Ukrainian and Romanian frontiers without changing the calendar date. Residents, crews, diplomats and authorised cases were excepted. September 1 restored green-origin entry while the red-origin exclusion continued with evolving exemptions. Decision 42 Annex 1 and the January 26, 2021 Border Police report confirm the later red-origin regime; vaccination was among its exemptions. Decision 48 explicitly repealed that annex and introduced quarantine-based entry rules from March 5, 2021; the Border Police confirms application to both citizens and foreigners at 00:00. The repeal text was inspected in a public reproduction because the original government PDF was inaccessible. This is a formal policy endpoint, not a first-passage log or proof that every person remained prohibited throughout. The March 16, 2022 certificate removal concerns later health requirements, not the end of the original exclusion.

REC50-R42-004-P1: The vehicle blockade is dated 30 January–17 February by onset, intermediate, morning-still-closed and actual restoration reports. Eighteen calendar days is not an elapsed-hour measurement. Several reports share AMSM origin. Reported pedestrian passage and early perishable-freight passage are excluded from a claim of universal closure; no all-person or all-Greece frontier closure is claimed.

Timing and exceptions: A Greek Police table and AMSM-derived account agree on 30 January but give different onset clocks. Reopening is confirmed on 17 February; bulletin publication times do not establish an exact clearance minute. Yeni Balkan's pedestrian exception was recovered in a full AVIM reproduction, while the perishable-goods report was available as substantive indexed text; neither establishes uninterrupted exception availability throughout the episode.

Specific purpose: Evzoni-specific contemporaneous AFP, ERT and Anadolu reporting now supports the tax and social-contribution protest rationale. No unsupported motive or exact daily rationale overlap is inferred.
